drivingQuestion: What does the clause 'two say he died' add?

segments.he: מַהוּ דְּתֵימָא: כִּי אָזְלִינַן בָּתַר רוֹב דֵּעוֹת — לְחוּמְרָא, אֲבָל לְקוּלָּא — לָא, קָא מַשְׁמַע לַן.
segments.en: The Gemara answers. This case is also necessary, «lest you say» that «when we follow the majority of opinions,» this is only when it leads «to a stringency, but» when this principle would lead «to a leniency,» to permit her to marry based on the majority of opinions, we do «not» follow the majority opinion. Therefore, the mishna «teaches us» that there is no difference in this regard, as the majority of opinions is accepted whether this leads to a lenient or a stringent outcome.
